name: audio_waveform
description: Visualise audio. kind waveform (default) draws a PNG of the whole waveform, spectrogram draws frequencies over time (useful for spotting noise, hum or clipping), and audiogram renders an MP4 with an animated waveform over a background image, the usual way to share podcast clips on social media. Images are attached to the result for vision models.

input.description: Path of the audio or video file, relative to the workspace.

width.description: Width in pixels. Default 1600 (1080 for audiograms).

height.description: Height in pixels. Default 400 waveform, 600 spectrogram, 1080 audiogram.

color.description: Waveform color: a name or hex (#4F8EF7, default).

background_image.description: For audiograms: background image (cover art), relative to the workspace.

output.description: Path for the result, relative to the workspace. PNG for images, MP4 for audiograms. Default: next to the input as <name>_<kind>.<ext>. An existing file is never replaced unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
